newsitem.title: UK: European vgo firmer, but puts buyers off.
newsitem.headline: European vgo firmer, but puts buyers off.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil was slow on Friday with higher prices on the back of crude putting buyers off.

Traders said the low sulphur material was tight even though U.S. demand has thinned. "The U.S. is not so interested following the midweek price hike," said one trader. The arb to the U.S. remained open.
A high sulphur cargo was sold on Thursday at around $143.5 fob Le Havre. The parcel was understood to be headed into Israel.
The market tone remains steady with maintenance at the BP/Texaco Nerefco refinery and firm crude acting as support.
